results.title: Integrating 21st-Century Skills into Mathematics Textbooks
results.content: # Integrating 21st-Century Skills into Mathematics Textbooks: Teachers’ Perspectives from Saudi Arabia. 21st-century skills; mathematics education; teacher perceptions; critical thinking; professional development. This study explored how middle school mathematics teachers in Saudi Arabia perceive the presence of 21st-century skills—such as critical thinking, creativity, communication, collaboration, and technology use—in the textbooks they teach from. Female teachers tended to place greater value on communication and creativity, and those with more than ten years of teaching experience reported that the textbooks reflected these skills more clearly than novice teachers did. Taken together, the results highlight the need for textbooks to make creativity and critical thinking more explicit, instead of leaving these skills to the discretion of individual teachers.
